author: Robin P
text: I was able to schedule a convenient time.  Rob showed up bright and early to fix my sliding toilet.  He found the problem, got the parts and now no more sliding.  He is quick and efficient.  Reasonably priced.  I would call him again.

author: holly nehas
text: We had a clogged tub drain and couldn’t be happier with the service. Joe was amazing! Scheduling the appointment was super easy, even for it being a Saturday, and he even called to let us know when he was on his way. He arrived early, quickly diagnosed the problem, and had the drain unclogged in less than 30 minutes. He was professional, friendly, and explained everything clearly. On top of that, the price was less than everyone else i called. We’re extremely satisfied and highly recommend Joe and Right On Time Plumbing.

author: Steve Zarley
text: Great professional service provided on time and at affordable rate.  Fixed my problem quickly.  Recommend Rob to anyone who needs immediate help fixing an urgent problem.

author: Colton Steele
text: Shower leaked horribly, Rob came out a day later and had it fixed within a couple hours. He explained the issue in detail, even though it may have been more complex than initially thought. He handled it with no complaints! 10/10 would recommend!

author: Tiffany Galvin
text: Called on a Monday and Tuesday morning at 8 they were able to be here! It was a quick fix from our own DIY sink/faucet install but we weren’t sure what was causing the leak! He found the issue within about 3 minutes and had it fixed in 10. Will absolutely call again. Prices in line with what I would expect and even gave advice on another side project we have going on.
